temperature_range: 300°C for Hf xSiyOz films, 200°C for Al2O3 films
summary: The study investigates the interfacial properties of Hf xSiyOz and Hf xSiyOz /Al2O3 films deposited by atomic layer chemical vapor deposition (ALCVD) on Si substrates. The formation of Hf-silicide at the Hf xSiyOz /Si interface is suppressed by Al2O3 interlayers, with thicker Al2O3 layers effectively blocking the reaction between Hf and Si atoms. The study also examines the effects of Al2O3 interlayers on the atomic structure and interface characteristics of the films.
evidence: HfxSiyOz films were deposited by ALCVD at 300°C using tetrakis-diethylamido-hafnium and tetra-n-butyl-orthosilicate. Al2O3 films were deposited at 200°C using trimethylaluminum and H2O. The formation of Hf-silicide at the Hf xSiyOz /Si interface was suppressed by Al2O3 interlayers, with thicker Al2O3 layers preventing Hf-silicide formation.
